My dear [Miss Butler](/person/237)
‘[Likes and Dislikes](/organisation/248)’ are beginning at last you see, and here is the first chapter of them, looking very inviting.

We have had great enjoyment in a visit from your cousin [Elizabeth](/person/113), I only wish her back was stronger.

Are you meditating any travels this summer, the [Packet](/periodical/52) wonders in rather an interested mood.

By the by, if you have any idea, I should be glad to know what sort of number of chapters you contemplate in the present story

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
